description: Censof internal Claude plugins — the GRP knowledge base connector and the tools built on it.

plugins.name: censof-mcp
plugins.description: Search the GRP knowledge base — 101k closed RFS tickets, Acumatica documentation, and the GRP manuals — and diagnose a support ticket end to end with the rfs-analyze skill.
